name: aris
description: Unknown market to a launch-ready package. Mine the public record, derive positioning from evidence, write every asset with a traceable claim, verify by script, and end in one HTML command centre. Four packages, sector-aware, fails closed on missing evidence.

plugins.name: aris-core
plugins.description: aris core: intake, the state contract, the sector knowledge base, the decision blocks, traceability and every gate.

plugins.name: aris-intel
plugins.description: aris intel: the category map, voice of customer mined from the public record, personas derived from quotes, market size from cited factors, and demand inferred rather than asserted.

plugins.name: aris-strategy
plugins.description: aris strategy: three scored positioning directions, messaging traceable to pain, and a channel mix argued from where the evidence came from.

plugins.name: aris-assets
plugins.description: aris assets: every launch material with a claim id, the dormant measurement harness, the conditional growth playbook, and the single-file HTML command centre.
